sections.title: First Quest
sections.note: Levels 1–8 each hold a Triforce piece and a boss's Heart Container. Screens are given as column A–P (west to east) and row 1–8 (north to south); the start is H8.

items.name: Level 1: The Eagle
items.area: Lake island north of the start (H4)
items.howTo: From the start screen go north and cross the bridge onto the island; the entrance is in the hollow tree. No item needed.
items.notes: Boss: Aquamentus. Items: Bow; Boomerang (dropped by the Goriyas).

items.name: Level 2: The Moon
items.howTo: In the hills of eastern Hyrule. No item needed.
items.notes: Boss: Dodongo (feed it bombs). Items: Magical Boomerang. Old Man: "DODONGO DISLIKES SMOKE."

items.name: Level 3: The Manji
items.area: Three screens west of the start (E8)
items.howTo: Go three screens west from the start screen. No item needed.
items.notes: Boss: Manhandla. Items: Raft. Old Man: "DID YOU GET THE SWORD FROM THE OLD MAN ON TOP OF THE WATERFALL?"

items.name: Level 4: The Snake
items.howTo: Sail the Raft from the dock one screen south (F6) to the island.
items.notes: Boss: Gleeok (two heads). Items: Stepladder, needed later in this level. Old Man: "WALK INTO THE WATERFALL." Mini-boss: Manhandla.

items.name: Level 5: The Lizard
items.area: Top of the Lost Hills, Death Mountain (L1)
items.howTo: Climb the Lost Hills by walking up four screens in a row (any other direction sends you back). The Stepladder is needed inside.
items.notes: Boss: Digdogger (play the Recorder to shrink it). Items: Recorder; Bomb upgrade (Old Man, 100 Rupees, carry 12). Old Man: "DIGDOGGER HATES CERTAIN KIND OF SOUND." Another Old Man: "SECRET POWER IS SAID TO BE IN THE ARROW." Zelda Dungeon's dungeon list says five screens up; Zelda Wiki and its walkthrough say four.

items.name: Level 6: The Dragon
items.howTo: Go through the Lost Woods (north, west, south, west) or take a Power Bracelet warp. Bring the Bow and Arrows: Gohma only dies to an arrow in its open eye.
items.notes: Boss: Gohma. Items: Magical Rod. Old Man: "AIM AT THE EYES OF GOHMA." Mini-boss: Gleeok (three heads).

items.name: Level 7: The Demon
items.area: The pond with no fairy, west Hyrule (C5)
items.howTo: Play the Recorder beside the pond to drain it and reveal the stairs ("there are secrets where fairies don't live"). Bring Food for the hungry Goriya inside, and the Stepladder.
items.notes: Boss: Aquamentus. Items: Red Candle; Bomb upgrade (Old Man, 100 Rupees, carry 16). Old Man: "THERE'S A SECRET IN THE TIP OF THE NOSE." Mini-bosses: Digdoggers and Dodongos.

items.name: Level 8: The Lion
items.howTo: Burn the lone bush with a Candle to open the stairs.
items.notes: Boss: Gleeok (four heads). Items: Book of Magic; Magical Key. Mini-bosses: Manhandlas and a Blue Gohma.

items.name: Level 9: Death Mountain
items.howTo: Bomb the left rock of Spectacle Rock. An Old Man inside lets you past only with all eight Triforce pieces. Ganon dies only to the Silver Arrow, found in this level.
items.reward: Triforce of Power; Princess Zelda rescued; the Second Quest opens on this file
items.notes: Boss: Ganon. Items: Silver Arrow; Red Ring. Mini-bosses: Patras. No Heart Container.

sections.title: Second Quest
sections.note: New levels in new places; it opens on the same file once the First Quest is beaten, or by naming a file ZELDA.

items.name: Level 1
items.area: Lake island north of the start (H4)
items.howTo: The same hollow tree as the First Quest's Level 1. No item needed.
items.notes: Boss: Aquamentus. Items: Boomerang. Map shape: E (Levels 1–5 spell ZELDA scrambled).

items.name: Level 2
items.howTo: Push the top-middle Armos statue, where the First Quest's Blue Ring shop was.
items.notes: Boss: Gleeok (two heads). Items: Recorder. Map shape: A. Mini-boss: Manhandla.

items.name: Level 3
items.howTo: Where the First Quest's Level 2 was. Bring Food: a hungry Goriya blocks the way to the Magical Boomerang (the Triforce doesn't need it).
items.notes: Boss: Three Dodongos. Items: Magical Boomerang. Map shape: L. The Dodongos guard the Compass, not the Triforce; Red Goriyas guard the Triforce room. Zelda Wiki puts the entrance under a pond in western Hyrule; StrategyWiki and Zelda Dungeon put it here.

items.name: Level 4
items.howTo: Push the rightmost boulder with the Power Bracelet. Bring 50 Rupees for the Old Man inside, or he takes a Heart Container. Take the Raft before the Triforce: the Triforce warps you out.
items.notes: Boss: Digdogger (splits in three). Items: Book of Magic; Raft; Bomb upgrade (Old Man, 100 Rupees, carry 12). Map shape: D. Mini-bosses: Digdogger, Aquamentus and Dodongos.

items.name: Level 5
items.howTo: The First Quest's Level 4 island: sail the Raft from the dock one screen south (F6).
items.notes: Boss: Gleeok (three heads). Items: Bow. Map shape: Z.

items.name: Level 6
items.howTo: Play the Recorder in the Graveyard to open a tombstone stairway.
items.notes: Boss: Blue Gohma (three arrows). Items: Stepladder.

items.name: Level 7
items.howTo: Burn the left tree of the pair at the top of the column, one screen west of the First Quest's Level 8. Get the Stepladder first or you can get stuck. Bring 100 Rupees for the two Old Men, or each takes a Heart Container.
items.notes: Boss: Gleeok (four heads). Items: Red Candle. Map shape: a spiral.

items.name: Level 8
items.area: One screen west of the waterfall (I2)
items.howTo: Stand on the river with the Stepladder and bomb the cliff to the north. Bring Food: a hungry Goriya blocks the way to the Magical Key.
items.notes: Boss: Three Dodongos. Items: Magical Rod; Magical Key; Bomb upgrade (Old Man, 100 Rupees, carry 16). Map shape: a spiral. Mini-bosses: Digdoggers and Aquamentus. StrategyWiki calls the hungry blocker a Moblin.

items.name: Level 9
items.howTo: Bomb the middle of the north wall. As in the First Quest, you need all eight Triforce pieces, and only the Silver Arrow kills Ganon.
items.reward: Triforce of Power; Princess Zelda rescued
items.notes: Boss: Ganon. Items: Silver Arrow; Red Ring. Map shape: Ganon's head. Mini-bosses: Patras. No Heart Container.
